_meta.title: Empty house composition model (Me/Natal)
structure: ruler placement (composed from planet-in-sign + planet-in-house banks)
fixes_vs_prior: no keyword stacks (lists capped at 3 concrete items)
no subject-verb agreement slips on plural house labels
dropped filler ('a birth chart can describe a pattern before it feels obvious')
ruler placement reused from banks instead of re-authored
_meta.inputs: house, cuspSign, rulerSign, rulerHouse (from the reader's chart)

boilerplate: Everyone has all twelve houses. An empty house just means no natal planet sits there. The area still works; it may simply run quietly instead of being a constant focus. You read it through the sign on its cusp and the planet that rules that sign, then follow that planet to see where the theme actually lives.

house_rich.1: how you present yourself, your body, and the first move you make
house_rich.2: money, possessions, and your felt sense of your own worth
house_rich.3: communication, learning, siblings, and the daily back-and-forth
house_rich.4: home, family, and your emotional foundation
house_rich.6: work, health, routines, and the daily fixing of things
house_rich.7: partnership, close others, and the agreements between you
house_rich.8: trust, shared money, debt, intimacy, and the obligations that come with relying on someone else
house_rich.9: belief, study, travel, and the meaning you reach for
house_rich.10: career, reputation, and your public standing
house_rich.11: friendships, groups, and the future you're building toward
house_rich.12: solitude, rest, the unconscious, and what you keep private

house_behavior.1: manage the impression you make and stay alert to how you are being read, before you have had time to register how you feel
house_behavior.2: hold tightly to money or possessions and use what you earn as proof of your worth, before you ask whether any of it helps you feel secure
house_behavior.3: rehearse what to say and work to keep the conversation moving, leaving little room to hear your own thoughts
house_behavior.4: retreat into familiar roles at home and guard your private space, even when what feels familiar no longer helps you feel safe
house_behavior.5: look for proof that other people like what you make, until their response matters more than your enjoyment
house_behavior.6: take on every task, tighten your routine, and keep going through exhaustion, until your body has to interrupt you
house_behavior.7: give generously and hope your partner understands what you need without being told, then swallow what bothers you to preserve the bond. Over time, the relationship can have room for them but very little room for you
house_behavior.8: hold back trust, keep a private tally of what each person owes, and prepare for betrayal before intimacy has had a chance to deepen
house_behavior.9: look for answers in another trip, course, or teacher before trusting what your own experience has already taught you
house_behavior.10: work harder to protect your reputation and control how others see you, until maintaining the role costs more than admitting it no longer fits
house_behavior.11: make yourself useful to the group and call it belonging, even when every gathering leaves you feeling depleted
house_behavior.12: withdraw, carry your worry in private, and tell yourself you can handle it alone, before you let anyone know how much it is costing you

house_about.1: who you are, how you get to show up, and whether you feel like yourself doing it
house_about.2: what you can earn and own, and whether you believe you are worth having enough
house_about.3: needing the right explanation, keeping up with what you do not know, and wondering whether you understand enough to trust your own conclusions
house_about.4: home, family, and whether you have a place that actually feels safe
house_about.5: being seen, having fun, and whether you are allowed to enjoy it without earning it
house_about.6: your health, your work, and whether you can keep it together without running yourself down
house_about.7: a close partnership, how decisions and responsibilities are shared, and whether both people have an equal say
house_about.8: trust, shared money and obligations, and whether you can depend on someone to follow through
house_about.9: whether you share the same values, have room to keep growing, and are building a life that still feels meaningful to you
house_about.10: your work, your reputation, and whether you measure up to what is expected
house_about.11: your friendships, where you belong, and whether these are really your people
house_about.12: what you carry privately, what you have not said out loud, and whether you can let anyone in

ruler_sign_clause_source: cc-ruler-sign-clauses.json (built from planet-in-sign bank; planet=function, sign=manner)

layer_roles.cusp_sign: names which planet rules the house (chain)
layer_roles.ruler_sign: HOW: the ruling planet's function + the sign's manner (from planet-in-sign bank)
layer_roles.ruler_house: WHERE: the arena the ruler connects this area to
layer_roles.empty_house: the coping behavior within this area
layer_roles.close: WHY: the deeper concern underneath, brought back toward this area

templates.chain: {Sign} is on the cusp of your empty {ord} house, so {ruler} rules {houseTheme[emptyHouse]}.
templates.placement: Your {Ruler} is in {RulerSign} in the {rulerOrd} house, connecting {houseShort[emptyHouse]} with {houseRich[rulerHouse]}. {rulerSignClause[ruler|rulerSign]}
templates.close: You may {houseBehavior[emptyHouse]}. Underneath, it's usually about {houseAbout[rulerHouse]}.

worked_examples.title: Empty 12th House in Taurus
worked_examples.boilerplate: Everyone has all twelve houses. An empty house just means no natal planet sits there. The area still works; it may simply run quietly instead of being a constant focus. You read it through the sign on its cusp and the planet that rules that sign, then follow that planet to see where the theme actually lives.
paragraphs: Taurus is on the cusp of your empty 12th house, so Venus rules your private, inner life.

Your Venus is in Capricorn in the 8th house, connecting your inner life with trust, shared money, debt, intimacy, and the obligations that come with relying on someone else. With Venus in Capricorn, you love with commitment and staying power; you invest where it can last.

You may withdraw, carry your worry in private, and tell yourself you can handle it alone, before you let anyone know how much it is costing you. Underneath, it's usually about trust, shared money and obligations, and whether you can depend on someone to follow through.

worked_examples.title: Empty 11th House in Aries
worked_examples.boilerplate: Everyone has all twelve houses. An empty house just means no natal planet sits there. The area still works; it may simply run quietly instead of being a constant focus. You read it through the sign on its cusp and the planet that rules that sign, then follow that planet to see where the theme actually lives.
paragraphs: Aries is on the cusp of your empty 11th house, so Mars rules your friendships and future.

Your Mars is in Aquarius in the 9th house, connecting your friendships with belief, study, travel, and the meaning you reach for. With Mars in Aquarius, you act on principle and your own timing, and you resist being told how to move.

You may make yourself useful to the group and call it belonging, even when every gathering leaves you feeling depleted. Underneath, it's usually about whether you share the same values, have room to keep growing, and are building a life that still feels meaningful to you.
